slides.text: When the tractor beam pulled me up into the flying saucer, the gray aliens probably expected me to scream. Instead, I immediately took off my pants and laid down on their cold metal examination table. 'Finally,' I sighed, closing my eyes. 'Do you guys have a chiropractor on board? My lower back has been killing me for three years. Probe away, just crack the L4 vertebra.'

The alien commander stared at me with giant, unblinking black eyes. 'We are here to conquer your planet and harvest your organs,' he communicated telepathically. I waved him off lazily. 'Yeah, yeah, get in line. The IRS is already harvesting my soul. Seriously, do you guys have Wi-Fi up here? I'm missing the season finale of The Bachelor, and if Brenda doesn't get a rose, I will riot.'

The commander looked at his crew. They huddled together, clicking nervously. Finally, the tractor beam engaged again, and I was violently ejected right back into my backyard, wearing only my socks. A small metallic device fell into the grass next to me. It was a holographic note. 'Your planet is too exhausting to conquer. Also, Brenda gets eliminated. Take some ibuprofen.'
